title: BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.19656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a persistent security threat to machine learning systems, yet their behavior under graph continual learning (GCL) remains underexplored. Conventional graph backdoor attacks often lose effectiveness as models are updated across successive tasks, creating the impression that continual updates naturally weaken malicious associations. This work reveals a contrasting vulnerability: knowledge-preservation mechanisms in GCL can also preserve early injected backdoors when the poisoned update is compatible with the clean-task signal being retained. For graph data, this risk is amplified by structural triggers, which are embedded into the message-passing paths of graph neural networks (GNNs) and can induce stable representation shifts across tasks. translated_title: BadGCL：针对图持续学习系统的持久性后门攻击
translated_abstract: 后门攻击对机器学习系统构成持续的安全威胁，然而其在图持续学习（GCL）中的行为仍未得到充分探索。传统的图后门攻击通常随着模型在连续任务中的更新而失去有效性，这给人一种持续更新会自然削弱恶意关联的印象。这项工作揭示了一种相反的脆弱性：当中毒更新与所保留的干净任务信号兼容时，GCL中的知识保留机制也可以保留早期注入的后门。对于图数据，这种风险被结构化触发器进一步放大，这些触发器被嵌入到图神经网络（GNN）的消息传递路径中，能够在跨任务中引起稳定的表示偏移。为了揭示这一风险，我们提出了BadGCL，这是一个在严格早期干预设置下实施持久后门攻击的模型无关框架。BadGCL学习拓扑感知的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出BadGCL框架，首次揭示图持续学习系统的知识保留机制会意外地保留早期注入的后门，且嵌入GNN消息传递路径的结构化触发器可在跨任务更新中维持持久攻击效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BadGCL, a model-agnostic framework revealing that knowledge-preservation mechanisms in graph continual learning can retain early-injected backdoors, with structural triggers embedded in GNN message-passing paths enabling persistent attack effects across tasks.
